Use a clearly oversized adult head, compact torso, and shortened legs; never render a 3.5-head, 4-head, or tall-miniature figure. Preserve relative body widths without generic inflation of the body. Use a grounded ready-idle three-quarter pose, both empty hands and both feet completely visible, with a generous safe margin and a warm pale parchment studio wash.

Identity continuity: Ori Wyren, age 37, gender presentation man, skin-value band 1; square compact face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; one brow notch Preserve adult age cues, face geometry, skin, and expression; use a calm closed mouth with no smile or theatrical acting. Body continuity: ordinary-average, tall; 182 cm; ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition. Preserve shoulder and torso width, mass, softness, muscle distribution, upper-arm and forearm girth, wrist scale, hand size, leg mass, and posture. Do not make the arms, hands, shoulders, torso, or body fatter or bulkier merely because this is chibi. Tall or slight identity must read through shape and posture without shrinking the head below the required chibi ratio.

Hair continuity: blue-teal braids-twists-locs; accent: none. Preserve the front and side silhouette of braids-twists-locs, the parting, gathered mass, shaved areas, and none; color remains blue-teal. Wardrobe continuity: layered-wrap in ochre-cream; overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds. Condition: deliberately tousled but clean. Preserve every visible seam, repair, closure, accessory, tattoo, marking, and palette relationship that survives at chibi scale. Personal anchors: a tiny nose stud; one asymmetric ear cuff. Add nothing new.
